description: Finding all my models or profile elsewhere than Civitai is without my consent ! Please don't repost my files. Send people to my Civitai profile, thanks :) -- My first attempt to make a slider. This is an Age Slider. It was trained with anime pics... but will work also on realistic stuff sometimes. It is far from perfect, so... FOR FUN AND TESTING :) -- V1 : HOW TO USE : Strength : -5 young to +5 old - but read below Steps : 9 to 15 tested Checkpoints : Any. I used mostly the Base FP8 and Base BF16 models. Adetailer : not used Other : I used the Lumina style CFG : 1 tested Sampler : EULER and DPM++ 3M SDE used, Sheduler : NORMAL used -- About the strength : Negative value will make the subject younger, however you won't get a child unless you use some trigger words I put in. Optional triggers for negative : a young person, japanese animation, white outfit, ((number for age like for the old person below) yo) person, standing, full body, (caucasian) girl (or boy), Positive value will make the subject older. However sometimes the image will go darker with generations with high values. Optional triggers for positive : an old person, japanese animation, 90yo old person, white outfit, standing, full body, (caucasian) man (or woman), -- Other : I have used this lora with two others of my creation and all worked together without a flaw. But I didn't test it with other creator content. -- Disclaimer : I'm not responsible for any misuse of this lora. This lora is not intended to be used to produce any nsfw generations.
